nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. Receives lead data from any CRM, form, or external system via HTTP POST.

nodes.name: Normalize Lead Fields
nodes.notes: Maps raw webhook body fields into clean, named variables. Auto-generates fullName and timestamps the request.

nodes.name: Email Present?
nodes.notes: Guards against leads with no email address. TRUE branch (email missing) returns a 400 error. FALSE branch continues to enrichment.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', code: 400, message: 'Validation failed: email is required.', received_at: $json.received_at }) }}

nodes.name: Return Validation Error
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 400 with a structured error JSON when email is missing. Terminates this branch.

values.content:
You are a senior B2B sales intelligence analyst. Analyze the lead information provided and return ONLY a valid JSON object — no markdown, no explanation, no extra text.

Return exactly this structure:
{
  "companySummary": "2-3 sentences describing what the company likely does, their market position, and typical business needs",
  "industry": "the most accurate industry label (e.g. SaaS, Financial Services, Healthcare Technology, E-commerce, Manufacturing, Professional Services)",
  "companySize": "one of: 1-10 | 11-50 | 51-200 | 201-1000 | 1000+",
  "businessType": "one of: B2B | B2C | B2B2C | Marketplace | Enterprise | Startup | SMB",
  "leadScore": integer between 0 and 100,
  "temperature": "one of: Cold | Warm | Hot",
  "recommendedAction": "one of: Schedule Demo | Send Proposal | Discovery Call | Follow-up Email | Not Qualified",
  "salesNotes": "2-3 actionable sentences a sales rep should know before contacting this lead — include buying signals, potential objections, and suggested talking points"
}

Scoring rules:
- 80-100 (Hot): Decision maker title, enterprise company, clear buying signal in notes, high-value industry
- 50-79 (Warm): Relevant role, mid-market company, some intent signals
- 0-49 (Cold): Junior title, unclear company, missing context, low-value signals

Temperature must match leadScore:
- Hot = 80-100
- Warm = 50-79
- Cold = 0-49

nodes.name: Enrich Lead with OpenAI
nodes.notes: GPT-4.1-mini analyzes the lead across 8 dimensions. Temperature 0.2 ensures consistent, analytical output rather than creative responses.

nodes.name: Parse & Validate Enrichment
nodes.notes: Safely parses the OpenAI JSON response. Validates every field against allowed values. Derives temperature from score if AI value is inconsistent. Applies safe defaults for all missing fields.

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Appends the fully enriched lead record to the CRM Leads sheet. Pulls original lead fields from the Normalize node and enrichment fields from the Parse node.

nodes.name: High Value Lead?
nodes.notes: Routes leads with score >= 80 to the Slack alert branch. All other leads go directly to the final response.

parameters.text:
=={{"🔥 High Value Lead

Company: " + $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.company + "
Name: " + $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.fullName + "
Email: " + $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.email + "
Score: " + $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.leadScore}}

nodes.name: Notify Sales via Slack
nodes.notes: Sends a rich Block Kit message to the sales Slack channel. Includes all key enrichment fields so the sales rep can act immediately without opening Sheets.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', slackNotified: true, lead: { name: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.fullName, company: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.company, email: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.email, country: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.country, jobTitle: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.jobTitle }, enrichment: { industry: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.industry, companySize: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.companySize, businessType: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.businessType, leadScore: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.leadScore, temperature: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.temperature, recommendedAction: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.recommendedAction, companySummary: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.companySummary, salesNotes: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.salesNotes } }) }}

nodes.name: Respond — High Value Lead
nodes.notes: Returns full enrichment response. slackNotified: true signals the caller that the sales team was alerted.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', slackNotified: false, lead: { name: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.fullName, company: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.company, email: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.email, country: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.country, jobTitle: $('Normalize Lead Fields').item.json.jobTitle }, enrichment: { industry: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.industry, companySize: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.companySize, businessType: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.businessType, leadScore: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.leadScore, temperature: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.temperature, recommendedAction: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.recommendedAction, companySummary: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.companySummary, salesNotes: $('Parse & Validate Enrichment').item.json.salesNotes } }) }}

nodes.name: Respond — Standard Lead
nodes.notes: Returns full enrichment response. slackNotified: false indicates score was below 80 and no alert was sent.
